name: aws-agent-toolkit
description: Call AWS APIs, search AWS documentation, and follow curated AWS skills
shortDescription: AWS API calls and documentation search

setup.notice: AWS credentials use environment variables, shared configuration, SSO, or instance roles. Direct access keys take precedence over profiles.
steps: Choose one or more AWS profiles to set the default and allow switching between profiles
Specify an AWS region if your profile does not set one
Alternatively, provide an access key ID and secret access key, plus a session token for temporary credentials
